data.explanation: This is a reminder from the city library (Stadtbibliothek) that two books you borrowed are past their due date. You already owe 4.50 € in late fees, which you can pay at the service desk or the payment machine when you return the items. Please return the items by the deadline shown in the letter: after that, fees rise by 0.50 € per item for every day the library is open, and once the total reaches 10.00 € your library account will be blocked from further borrowing. You can drop items in the 24-hour return box, or renew the loan online yourself if no one else has reserved the items. This is only a library notice, not a legal or court matter, but returning the items promptly avoids extra fees.

items.consequence: Fees increase by 0,50 € per item per opening day after the deadline, and the account is blocked for further loans once fees reach 10,00 €.

items.title: Pay accumulated library fees
items.action: Pay the 4,50 € in fees at the service desk or the payment machine, typically when returning the items.
items.consequence: Unpaid fees continue to accrue and can lead to further increases and an account block.
items.quote: Die bisher entstandenen Gebühren in Höhe von 4,50 € können Sie bei der Rückgabe an der Servicetheke oder am Kassenautomaten bezahlen.
